WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,c.name AS name,c.hyBlkRefName AS hyBlkRefName,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info c ON c.mktcode=b.mktcode AND c.tgtcode=b.tgtcode
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
    AND (b.mktcode=1 OR b.mktcode=0 OR b.mktcode=103)
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=5 THEN AVG(CAST(`v1` AS DECIMAL(38,18))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    `v1` AS `f2`,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tgtcode=? OR name=? THEN `v1` END) OVER (PARTITION BY bizdate) AS `f3`
  FROM history
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)>=6) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM counted WHERE bizdate = ?
),
prefiltered AS (
  SELECT * FROM current_rows WHERE (`c1` AND (`f2` >= `f3`))
),
rank_input AS (
  SELECT * FROM prefiltered WHERE `v1` IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT rank_input.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `v1` ASC) AS `r1`
  FROM rank_input
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM ranked
WHERE (`r1` <= ?)
ORDER BY `r1`,mktcode,tgtcode
LIMIT 9;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
    AND (b.mktcode=1 OR b.mktcode=0 OR b.mktcode=103)
),
history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=24
),
lookup_series AS (
  SELECT b.bizdate AS lookup_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN (b.tgtcode=? OR c.name=?) THEN b.closePrice END) AS `f2`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info c ON c.mktcode=b.mktcode AND c.tgtcode=b.tgtcode
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ? AND (b.mktcode=1 OR b.mktcode=0 OR b.mktcode=103) AND ((b.tgtcode=? OR c.name=?))
  GROUP BY b.bizdate
),
features AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=5 THEN AVG(CAST(`v1` AS DECIMAL(38,18))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    lookup_series.`f2` AS `f2`
  FROM observed_tail LEFT JOIN lookup_series ON lookup_series.lookup_date=observed_tail.bizdate
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > `f2`) AS `pc1`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=20 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)>=6) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM counted WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE `c1`
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;
